promos.description: Each promo reward card on the page. Each card represents a single discounted route + cabin combination.

carrier.description: Operating carrier shown on the card — typically 'Air France' or 'KLM'.

origin_label.description: Origin city or region label, e.g. 'Paris', 'Amsterdam', 'Europe'.

dest_label.description: Destination city or region label, e.g. 'Geneva', 'New York', 'Mexico City'.

cabin.description: Cabin class — Economy, Premium, Business, or First.

discount_percent_displayed.description: Discount percent shown on the card (e.g. 25 for '-25%'). Null if not displayed.

extra_exclusive.description: True if the card is labeled 'Extra Exclusive' (Flying Blue Extra subscribers only).

valid_through.description: When the promo window closes, e.g. 'October 31, 2026'. Look for text like 'travel through' or 'until'.
